name: HZ_IMP_ERRORS
description: The import process uses HZ_IMP_ERRORS table to record all errors that occur during import.

columns.name: ERROR_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Unique id of error record

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Indicates that an error has occurred for the record. Also used to join to the appropriate row in the errors table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the batch

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Message name

columns.name: TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN2_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN2_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN3_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN3_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN4_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN4_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN5_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message

columns.name: TOKEN5_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Associated interface table.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG_TEXT
columns.description: This contains stack trace or error message text of the error that occurred while processing the interface record.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Column value distinguishes error versus warning.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.
